page.overview:
What is Island?

Islands are a recurring type of location found throughout the Final Fantasy series. They are usually remote locations and can only be accessed by boat, airship, or even by riding a special chocobo. They often are home to dungeons, precious treasure, or powerful monsters.

The Cardian Islands are home to the Dragon Caves, where the king of Dragons, Bahamut, resides. An airship is required to reach them, as there are no docks nearby.

The Tropical Island is a remote island where the Black Mask is kept. It is home to several exotic monsters and a peculiar tribe of masked men.

The Mysidian Tower is located on an island southwest of Altair and north of Mysidia, and access to it is protected by a round mountain range with a small entrance. Leviathan protects this way into the small sea.

entity.description:
? Island is one of the eleven islands of The Great Sea in Paper Mario: The Origami King. It is located in the B-5 Tile on the Sea Chart. The island consists of Origami Stone Spikes, Origami Sidesteppers, many Question Blocks, and a Paper Macho Stone Spike on top of the hill. A Sensor Lab can be located here.

The island as the name says it is shaped like a question mark. It is a grassy island with slopes where the Origami Stone Spikes throws rocks. In the center area are a floor made out of Question Blocks where the Sidestepers are located. There is a little entrace at the side who leads to a underground part with chest that contains a Collectible and a block that releases a POW Block who can be used to hit the ? Blocks.
